labels.derived: arithmetic on ledger fills / venue rows; e.g. the paying side is derived by reproducing realized_usd from the ledger payout
labels.counterfactual: did not happen: a refused order treated as filled at its own maker price and (i) held to the venue's actual settlement or (ii) paired at the complement touch L5 later saw; queue position, depth and the $7.50 spend cap are NOT modelled; never inferred from a mark
labels.PENDING: market not settled; settlement counterfactual withheld
labels.fill_readings: all_refusals_fill = every refused order fills (upper bound; consecutive refusals are one L5 intention re-attempted); first_of_each_run_fills = one fill per consecutive run
labels.time: strict = seconds from the first to the last refusal of a run; inclusive = strict + the last refusal's next_reevaluation_s

verdict: The $2.50 unmatched-dollar cap overrode 62 of 217 R4 decisions (29%), every one of them an L5 EXTEND, i.e. 62 of the 109 extends L5 sampled (57%); by market -- aec-atp-petbru-alecan: 18/73 decisions, 18/54 sampled extends, 564s of 2229s live; aec-atpcq-aleher-tundur: 9/79 decisions, 9/18 sampled extends, 270s of 876s live; aec-atpcq-norgom-ollwal: 35/65 decisions, 35/37 sampled extends, 282s of 1166s live. It withheld 134.7185 USD of orders across 21 consecutive runs (44.8006 USD counting one order per run), 319.87 YES / 0.00 NO contracts never built, and held the engine in cap-refusal for 1116s of 4271s of live session time (26%). On the 3 settled market(s), had every refused order filled and been held to the venue's actual settlement the extra inventory would have made -90.7785 USD (-29.7706 USD on the one-fill-per-run reading) (the paying side of aec-atpcq-norgom-ollwal is read from the venue's public settlement price and is unconfirmed; had the opposite side paid the held figure would be 141.2115 USD all-fill / 48.6094 USD per run); paired instead at the complement touch L5 later saw it would have made 11.6480 USD (4.4149 USD per run). Those are counterfactual, fill-assumed, fee-free numbers, not realized ones; L5's OPEN and COMPLETE decisions were never touched by this cap; its EXTEND leg was mostly suppressed, so the R4 sequence is L5's opens and completes with L5's extends largely removed.
